headline: Deficit-to-GDP Ratio at 3.1%, Italy Remains Under EU Excessive Deficit Procedure. Salvini: "Surreal". Giorgetti: "We regretfully take note of the Istat data"
summary: Istat data put Italy's deficit at 3.1% of GDP, above the EU's 3% threshold, so the country remains under the Excessive Deficit Procedure. Finance Minister Giorgetti said the data was regrettably noted.
why: The EU Excessive Deficit Procedure can constrain national budgets and affects how investors price Italian government debt. Italy is one of the euro area's largest economies.
